action: Reach out to Devon Clarke through Angela Wright's introduction. Text Angela first: 'Hey, I want to reach out to Devon this week — can I use your name?' Then contact Devon directly: not email, a phone call. Frame it around his specific problem — a mobile service business with no fixed location lives or dies on its social presence, and the RoboRide residential expansion means the neighborhoods he serves are changing faster than any static marketing can track. Offer a 30-minute call, no pitch, just an honest conversation about where his social presence is and where it needs to be. If the fit is real, send the one-page agreement within 48 hours. Target: $350/month retainer, same structure as the HVAC client.
